items.title: Occidental Announces 1st Quarter 2026 Results
items.snippet: Q1 2026 results; reported revenue-related context via operating performance and guidance commentary. Key disclosed metrics include net income attributable to common stockholders of $3.2 billion, EPS of $3.13, adjusted EPS of $1.06, and total company production of 1,426 Mboed.

items.title: Occidental Announces 4th Quarter 2025 Results
items.snippet: Latest prior quarterly release with guidance context. Disclosed net loss of $68 million, adjusted income of $315 million, and total global production of 1,481 Mboed, surpassing the mid-point of guidance.
